easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Basal Sliver dies, Yedora triggers, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Basal Sliver enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basal Sliver by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Basal Sliver face-up.
Repeat.
